description: Places around a surf town, closest to the surf first (as on the site): stay (Places to stay), coffee (Coffee), food (Food & drinks), surf (Surf shops & schools), spots (Surf spots (community mapped)). Stays are a saved, merged OpenStreetMap + Overture Maps collection (hotels, resorts, hostels, surf camps, guesthouses, homestays, B&Bs, holiday rentals, villas, camping) with website, phone, email, socials, stars, rooms and facilities where known. Cafés, food and surf shops/schools are a saved Overture Maps collection too; community-mapped surf spots are a live OpenStreetMap lookup. Places with a reviewed, freely licensed photo (Wikimedia Commons) include it as photo { url, page, author, license }. Each place has distanceKm from the town centre and nearestSpot { name, distanceKm }: the town's curated surf spot closest to it. sort: "surf" (default) puts the places closest to any surf spot first, "distance" closest to the town centre, "stars" (places to stay) most stars first, "name" A–Z; spot (a surf spot's name from get_town) puts the places closest to that one spot first, each with toSpot { name, distanceKm }. sortedBy says the order used (a town without curated spots is in order from its centre).

kind.description: Only one kind of place, e.g. stay: "surf_camp", "hostel", "homestay"; coffee: "cafe", "bakery"; food: "restaurant", "bar"; surf: "school", "shop".

sort.description: Order: "surf" closest to a surf spot first (the default, as on the site), "distance" closest to the town centre, "stars" most stars first (places to stay), "name" A–Z.

spot.description: A surf spot of the town (its name, from get_town): places closest to this spot first.

name: nearby_places
title: Places near a surf town
